justification: Changes which council rows the quote check can prove, and the quote text shown, for chapters whose PDF text layer holds every line twice. Only Campbelltown Part 3 qualifies today.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: doubled lines are not dropped (the antenna rule is refused), or short repeated table cells mark a chapter as doubled
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 2026-10-29: DOUBLED_SHARE set to 9 -> test_a_text_layer_holding_every_line_twice_is_read_once FAILED; DOUBLED_MIN_CHARS set to 0 -> test_a_table_with_repeated_short_cells_is_not_read_as_doubled FAILED. Restored, 70 pass.

pre_impl.existing_data: 2026-10-29 read-only run over every chapter with an unproven shown rule: share of 20+ character lines repeating the line before = 0.33 for campbelltown-dcp-part3-low-medium.pdf, next highest 0.04. In that chapter 43 hidden rules become 29 exact + 3 recovered; 1 recovered rule (253636, whose stored text itself repeats a phrase) becomes unconfirmed; 153 of 461 shown quotes currently print lines twice and are re-copied once.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The checker assumed each printed line appears once in the text layer.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One filter on the lines a Stream reads; no new status, table or column.

functions.name: doubled_lines
functions.input: the lines of one chapter reading, in reading order
functions.output: indexes of lines that repeat the line before on the same page, only when 15%+ of 20+ character lines do; else empty set
functions.if_none: an empty chapter has no lines, returns an empty set, nothing dropped

values.if_missing: empty list: no doubled lines, stream is empty as before

break_it.scenario: A plant table where short cells ('Y', 'Y', 'Shrub') repeat on consecutive lines.
break_it.what_happens: Real table cells would be dropped and table quotes broken (Wollongong E6 scored 0.23 when short lines counted).
break_it.how: Only lines of 20+ characters decide the share; test covers it.

break_it.scenario: A normal chapter that prints one sentence twice in a row on purpose.
break_it.what_happens: The council's real wording would be shortened.
break_it.how: Lines are dropped only when the whole chapter is doubled; test covers a single repeat.

break_it.scenario: A stored rule that copied the doubled text ('proposed over the other allotments' twice).
break_it.what_happens: It was proven before by matching the doubled layer; it would show garbled text.
break_it.how: With the layer read once, the repeat is not on the page, so it stays hidden; test covers it.

post_merge.db_reset: Yes: re-check Campbelltown Part 3 rows with council_quote.py --apply after a backup, so stored quotes and statuses match.
